It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Pyrenees for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Melchsee-Frutt's reputation as a family resort is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a relaxed atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. The altitude of Melchsee-Frutt (1080 m at the base, 2255 m at the top) allows it to maintain decent snow cover in mid-winter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it is worth checking conditions before finalising a booking.
